source.excerpt: Lips red as the rose, hair black as ebony, skin white as snow
trail: The Magic Mirror describes Snow White with this line in Disney’s 1937 film. Wikiquote transcribes the dialogue and lists the film’s shared story-writing credits. Source and attribution evidence ↗

The credited team comprises Ted Sears, Richard Creedon, Otto Englander, Dick Rickard, Earl Hurd, Merrill De Maris, Dorothy Ann Blank, and Webb Smith. The source does not assign this individual sentence to one member. Read the supporting source ↗
source.excerptNote: An excerpt of the wording under discussion; see the source and attribution limitations below.
source.rightsNote: The film was released after 1930 and its screen dialogue remains in copyright. Studio rights are separate from the writing or performance credit; no reuse licence is asserted.
